prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Phoenix for a car accident case?
competitors_mentioned: State Bar of Arizona’s lawyer-referral service
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” Phoenix car-accident lawyer—the right choice depends on injury severity, insurance limits, whether fault is disputed, and whether you need a firm prepared to litigate rather than settle quickly.

For a serious Phoenix case, prioritize a lawyer who:

- Regularly handles Arizona auto-injury and trial cases—not only high-volume settlements  
- Has experience with your issue: uninsured/underinsured motorist coverage, commercial vehicles, rideshare crashes, catastrophic injury, wrongful death, or disputed fault  
- Personally reviews the case and can explain expected fees, costs, medical liens, and case strategy  
- Has verifiable trial results and no significant State Bar discipline history  

Well-known Phoenix-area firms that handle car-accident claims include **The Husband & Wife Law Team (Breyer Law Offices), Phillips Law Group, Goldberg & Osborne, Lerner and Rowe, Zanes Law, and Smith & Green**. Name recognition alone should not decide it; ask who specifically will manage your claim and whether that lawyer will take the case to trial if necessary.

A strong way to find a fit is to contact 2–3 firms and ask:

1. “Will a lawyer—not just a case manager—evaluate my case?”  
2. “How many similar cases have you tried or resolved recently?”  
3. “Who will handle negotiations and litigation?”  
4. “What is the contingency fee, and are case costs deducted before or after the fee?”  
5. “Do you have experience with my insurer and Arizona UM/UIM claims?”  

You can also use the **State Bar of Arizona’s lawyer-referral service** and check whether the attorney is certified or recognized in personal-injury/wrongful-death practice.

If you share whether the crash involved serious injuries, a commercial/rideshare driver, uninsured coverage, or disputed fault, I can suggest what type of Phoenix lawyer or firm profile is most appropriate.
